summary_markdown: The user was experiencing difficulty running `helm upgrade` commands for the mops staging environment, receiving a 'connection refused' error when trying to reach `http://localhost:8080/version`. The issue stemmed from missing Kubernetes configuration. [p1] advised the user to run the command `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name allunite` to properly set up the necessary cluster credentials.
decisions: The required step was identified: running `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name allunite`.
